name: showtime
description: A local video studio for your coding agent. Describe a video. Your agent directs. Your machine renders. Motion graphics, voice-over, music, footage editing, captions and platform-ready exports, with no cloud AI services or API keys.

interface.longDescription: Describe a video in one sentence; the model directs and your machine renders it. showtime makes launch films, explainers, data stories, repo and paper explainers, release videos and social shorts as HTML/CSS/canvas frames rendered frame-exact in headless Chrome, with local voice-over, music and sound effects, captions, footage editing and Manim for math. Every finished video is checked before you see it: text cut off or too small on a phone, text held too briefly to read, black or frozen frames, loudness, and a review round by a reviewer that did not build it. You get an MP4, a single-file HTML video and platform-ready exports, plus a receipt of what the video took. Everything runs on your computer with open models and tools installed once by `showtime setup`; nothing is uploaded and there are no cloud AI services or API keys of its own. MIT licensed.
defaultPrompt: Make a 30-second launch video for this repo that I can post on X.
Turn data.csv into a 45-second animated data story for YouTube.
Explain this codebase in a 60-second video that follows one request through the real files.
